subject: Workplace Skills
title: Underpromise and Overdeliver
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Underpromise and Overdeliver.

hook.text: Amazon always shows delivery estimates one day late. When the package arrives early, customers are delighted.

buildup.text: Expectations are the benchmark against which all performance is judged. Set them low and exceeding is easy.

discovery.text: This is not about sandbagging. It is about building in realistic margins for the unexpected.

twist.text: Overpromising feels generous. But the person who delivers 90% of an ambitious promise is judged harshly.

climax.text: Add a 20% buffer to every estimate. Use the buffer to polish or deliver early. Either way, you win.

punchline.text: Buffer your promises. Early delivery delights.

quiz.question: Why does underpromising and overdelivering build trust?
options: It keeps expectations artificially low forever
It allows you to do less work overall
